d.ko: 복수를 위해 전속력으로 달려가는 Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider는 16비트 고전 액션 게임의 황금기를 떠올리게 하는 횡스크롤 액션 플랫폼 게임입니다.
d.en:
Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider is a side-scrolling action platformer that channels the golden age of classic 16-bit action games in a full-throttle quest for revenge.

Created to defend a totalitarian state, the Moonrider rejects its programming and now seeks vengeance on its creators.
d.zh: 《Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider》是一款横版动作平台游戏，它将经典16位动作游戏的黄金时代融入到全力以赴的复仇之路中。
